newsitem.title: USA: President Casinos closes real estate deal.
newsitem.headline: President Casinos closes real estate deal.

text.p: President Casinos Inc said Thursday it has completed the acquisition of certain real estate and improvements located on the Gulf Coast in Biloxi, Miss. from J. Edward Connelly Associates Inc (JECA) for about $40.5 million.

The property comprises about 260 acres and includes the Broadwater Resort and Broadwater Tower, two hotels with over 500 rooms, a 138-slip marina, and an adjacent 18-hole golf course. The marina is currently the site of President Casino's casino operations in Biloxi and is leased by President Casino from JECA under a long-term lease agreement. JECA is wholly
owned by John Connelly, the chairman and principal stockholder of President Casino.

President Casino has invested $5.0 million in a newly formed subsidiary, President Broadwater Hotel LLC which has purchased the Broadwater properties. In addition, this subsidiary has financed the purchase with $30.0 million of outside financing and $10.0 million of purchase money preferred equity from JECA. Such financing is non-recourse to President Casinos.
President Casinos said this site could be developed as a full-scale luxury destination resort with casinos and the company intends to seek a joint venture partner to develop this site.
President Casinos owns and operates riverboat and dockside gaming facilities in Davenport, Iowa, Biloxi, Miss. and St. Louis, Mo..
